from.place: specialization of regular finite-dimensional duality to the projective line: smooth affine-line charts

title: The projective line is smooth of relative dimension one
statement: For any scheme S [def-pc-scheme], the structure morphism of the projective line P(ULift(Fin 2); S) [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] to S is smooth of relative dimension one [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].

proof.text: Use the existing, proved source-library instance ProjectiveLine.smoothOfRelativeDimension_one. Every point lies in a standard open D_+(T_i). Its chart is affine space with variables indexed by the complement of i in ULift(Fin 2), a set of cardinality one. The affine-space projection is smooth of relative dimension one; the property is local on the source, so these charts prove it for the projective line. This includes the empty base (the local condition is vacuous); it requires no field or perfectness hypothesis.
